apps.name: JetGlass
apps.subtitle: Liquid Glass plane spotter
apps.localizedDescription: JetPhotos + FlightRadar24 in a liquid-glass iOS 26 app. Live map with airline labels and ICAO airport search, photo search and downloads via jetapi.dev.
apps.versionDescription: FR24-style plane card: big photo banner on top with details underneath (route with times, airspeed, altitude). Live traffic now comes from adsb.lol first — more planes on the map, and registrations included so photos work. Planes now glide to their new positions between refreshes.
